UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Summit Navigator attendee profile verified via Google Sign-In and Email OTP MFA.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

mfaVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent Email OTP verification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

SessionQuestion.title: SessionQuestion
SessionQuestion.description: Real-time audience question posted to a summit session with speaker moderation flags and atomic upvote counter.

id.description: Firestore document ID for the question.

sessionId.description: Identifier of the summit session this question belongs to.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting attendee.

authorName.description: Public display label for the question author or Anonymous.

isAnonymous.description: Whether the attendee chose to hide their name publicly.

pinned.description: Speaker/moderator pin flag to highlight priority questions.

answered.description: Speaker/moderator status indicating the question has been addressed.

archived.description: Speaker/moderator flag hiding resolved or off-topic questions from the active feed.

moderatedBy.description: UID of the speaker or moderator who last changed moderation flags, or empty string if unmoderated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the question was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest upvote or moderation update.

QuestionUpvote.title: QuestionUpvote
QuestionUpvote.description: Per-user upvote marker ensuring one upvote per verified attendee per question via deterministic document IDs.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the attendee who upvoted.

questionId.description: Identifier of the upvoted question document.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the upvote was recorded.

Moderator.title: Moderator
Moderator.description: Assigned speaker or moderator record granting live Q&A moderation privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the assigned speaker or moderator.

role.description: Moderation or organizer admin role assigned.

grantedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who granted moderation access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when moderation access was granted.

AttendeePass.title: AttendeePass
AttendeePass.description: Signed digital QR credential and real-time on-site check-in state for an MFA-verified summit attendee.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the attendee.

fullName.description: Attendee full name printed on the digital pass.

checkedInBy.description: UID of attendee or organizer who recorded check-in, or empty string if Confirmed.

checkedInAt.description: ISO timestamp of check-in, or empty string if Confirmed.

mfaVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp of Email OTP verification backing the QR pass.

qrSignatureDigest.description: Cryptographic digest fingerprint of the server-signed QR pass token.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when pass was provisioned.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when pass status or metadata last changed.

SessionPoll.title: SessionPoll
SessionPoll.description: Real-time speaker-launched multiple-choice poll or 1-tap commitment prompt with live aggregate option counts.

id.description: Firestore document ID for the poll.

pollType.description: Distinguishes multi-option polls from 1-tap commitment/sentiment prompts.

question.description: Prompt or question presented by the speaker.

options.description: Bounded list of 2 to 5 selectable response labels.

optionCount.description: Exact number of active choices (2 to 5).

count0.description: Aggregate response count for option index 0.

count1.description: Aggregate response count for option index 1.

count2.description: Aggregate response count for option index 2.

count3.description: Aggregate response count for option index 3.

count4.description: Aggregate response count for option index 4.

totalVotes.description: Total verified attendee responses recorded on this poll.

status.description: Live voting status controlled by speakers/moderators.

archived.description: Whether the speaker/moderator archived this poll from active session view.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the speaker/moderator who launched the poll.

createdByName.description: Public speaker or moderator display label.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the poll was launched.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest vote or status update.

PollVote.title: PollVote
PollVote.description: Deterministic per-user poll response marker keyed by {pollId}_{uid} ensuring one vote per verified attendee.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the responding attendee.

pollId.description: Identifier of the answered poll document.

optionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the chosen poll option (0 to 4).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vote was cast.

DirectoryProfile.title: DirectoryProfile
DirectoryProfile.description: Opt-in verified leadership and speaker networking profile discoverable by ministry role and session track (PII-free).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the opted-in member.

fullName.description: Public display name in the leadership directory.

role.description: Ministry role used for directory filtering.

memberType.description: Indicates whether the opted-in profile is an attendee or verified speaker/moderator.

bio.description: Brief ministry focus or collaboration bio.

focusTopics.description: Up to 5 short ministry focus topics.

optedIn.description: Explicit user opt-in controlling directory visibility.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the directory profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest opt-in or profile update.

DirectoryConnection.title: DirectoryConnection
DirectoryConnection.description: Cross-organization peer or attendee-to-speaker connection introduction between opted-in directory members.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the leader initiating the connection.

recipientUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the opted-in directory recipient.

replyNote.description: Optional reply or preferred contact note shared by the recipient upon accepting.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the connection request was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the connection status changed.

SessionOverride.title: SessionOverride
SessionOverride.description: Admin-managed live overrides for summit session times, duration allocations, slide decks, and downloadable study packets.

time.description: Scheduled time window label for the session.

prayer.description: Prayer and transition duration in minutes.

studyPacketTitle.description: Title of the downloadable study packet.

studyPacketNotes.description: Organizer study packet notes, discussion prompts, and action steps included in downloads.

slides.description: Bounded list of up to 8 presentation slide objects.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the organizer or speaker who last edited this session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session override was first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session content was last edited.

SpeakerOverride.title: SpeakerOverride
SpeakerOverride.description: Admin-managed speaker role and biography updates synced across speaker profiles and directory cards.

speakerKey.description: URL-safe slug key identifying the summit speaker.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin or speaker who updated this bio.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when speaker override was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when speaker bio was updated.

RegistrationRecord.title: RegistrationRecord
RegistrationRecord.description: Organizer-managed attendee registration record supporting single and bulk approval workflows.

updatedBy.description: UID of organizer who last approved or modified status, or empty string on initial signup.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was stored in Firestore.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest status or bulk approval update.

ActionPlanItem.title: ActionPlanItem
ActionPlanItem.description: Interactive 30/60/90-day post-summit action checklist item assigned to an attendee's church and ministry department.

id.description: Firestore document ID for the action checklist item.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning attendee.

sessionId.description: Summit session identifier from which this takeaway originates.

sessionTitle.description: Display title of the originating summit session.

notes.description: Optional implementation steps or Scripture anchor.

horizonDays.description: Target implementation horizon in days post-summit (30, 60, or 90).

department.description: Assigned ministry department or functional team.

assigneeLabel.description: Lead person or role responsible for follow-through.

dueDateIso.description: Target YYYY-MM-DD due date computed from summit baseline and horizon.

completedAtIso.description: ISO timestamp when marked completed, or empty string if active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when action item was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest status or assignment update.

ActionReminderPreference.title: ActionReminderPreference
ActionReminderPreference.description: Profile-synced progress reminder cadence, default church/department assignment, and 30/60/90-day baseline date.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the attendee.

enabled.description: Whether scheduled accountability progress reminders are active.

cadence.description: Frequency of ministry accountability check-in reminders.

reminderDay.description: Preferred day of the week for accountability review.

churchName.description: Church or organization name synced with attendee profile.

defaultDepartment.description: Primary ministry department for new action items.

summitDateIso.description: YYYY-MM-DD summit completion date anchoring 30/60/90-day targets.

lastCheckInIso.description: ISO timestamp of most recent accountability check-in, or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when reminder settings were initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest reminder preference update.

ReminderSubscription.title: ReminderSubscription
ReminderSubscription.description: Scheduled outbound email digest subscription synced with each attendee's 30/60/90-day action plan progress and cadence.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the subscribed attendee.

email.description: Verified attendee email address receiving scheduled digests.

displayName.description: Attendee full name for email personalization.

enabled.description: Whether automated reminder dispatches are active.

reminderDay.description: Preferred day of the week for email digest delivery.

defaultDepartment.description: Primary ministry department for the attendee.

lastCheckInIso.description: ISO timestamp of latest manual accountability check-in.

lastEmailedAtIso.description: ISO timestamp of most recent outbound digest email.

dueSoonCount.description: Count of incomplete milestones due within 14 days.

topOpenTitles.description: Bounded preview of up to 5 top open action items for offline email digests.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest sync or cron dispatch.

ReminderDispatchLog.title: ReminderDispatchLog
ReminderDispatchLog.description: Immutable outbound digest delivery audit log recorded by scheduled cron runs, admin batches, or user test sends.

id.description: Firestore document ID for the dispatch log.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the recipient attendee.

recipientEmail.description: Email address targeted by this dispatch.

cadence.description: Cadence active when the digest ran.

triggerSource.description: Source that initiated the email dispatch.

openCount.description: Open milestones included in the digest.

overdueCount.description: Overdue milestones included in the digest.

dueSoonCount.description: Due-soon milestones included in the digest.

errorMessage.description: Failure reason if status is failed, otherwise empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when dispatch log was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores verified attendee profile data scoped strictly to the owning authenticated user.

/attendeePasses/{userId}.description: Real-time digital QR badge credentials and Confirmed/Checked In status per MFA-verified attendee.

/moderators/{userId}.description: Stores speaker, moderator, and admin role assignments managed by the bootstrapped summit administrator.

/sessions/{sessionId}/questions/{questio.description: Real-time shared audience questions for each summit session with moderation flags and upvote counts.

/sessions/{sessionId}/upvotes/{upvoteId}.description: Deterministic per-user upvote documents keyed by {questionId}_{uid} synchronized atomically with SessionQuestion.upvotesCount.

/sessions/{sessionId}/polls/{pollId}.description: Real-time multiple-choice polls and 1-tap commitment prompts with aggregate response counts.

/sessions/{sessionId}/pollVotes/{voteId}.description: Deterministic per-user vote receipts keyed by {pollId}_{uid} paired atomically with SessionPoll option counts.

/directoryProfiles/{userId}.description: Opt-in attendee and speaker networking directory profiles filtered by ministry role and summit track.

/directoryConnections/{connectionId}.description: Cross-organization leadership connection requests and acceptances between opted-in directory members.

/sessionOverrides/{sessionId}.description: Organizer-edited session times, minute allocations, slide decks, and downloadable study packets.

/speakerOverrides/{speakerKey}.description: Organizer-edited speaker bios and specialty titles.

/registrations/{registrationId}.description: Persistent attendee registrations for role-based organizer bulk approvals and check-in tracking.

/users/{userId}/actionItems/{itemId}.description: Profile-synced 30/60/90-day post-summit ministry accountability checklist items per attendee.

/users/{userId}/actionPreferences/{prefI.description: Profile-synced accountability reminder cadence and default church/department preferences.

/reminderSubscriptions/{userId}.description: Scheduled outbound email digest subscriptions synced with each attendee's 30/60/90-day action plan progress.

/reminderDispatchLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable outbound digest delivery audit log recorded by scheduled cron runs, admin batches, and user test sends.
